source.note: Plan row #157 was the Quaternius water tower on the poly.pizza CDN, which answers with a Cloudflare challenge; substituted with Kenney City Kit Industrial 2.0 water-tower.glb (the same zip and pin as the windmill entry). Also rendered: KayKit City Builder Bits 1.0 watertower.gltf (GitHub raw, commit 63976910ca04d16f0fc531b9c614244be8128713), which is a squat NYC-style rooftop barrel tank on short legs; the Kenney one reads better as the classic tall legged tower (four splayed legs with three tiers of ring braces, a platform with a railing ring, a cylindrical tank and a conical roof). Height 18 m (real 15-25 m); the footprint is about 7 x 7 m, the tank 4.5 m across. The model is four-fold symmetric, so it has no front; no yaw. Noon script: tank moon over sky shade; the source's orange tank band and the blue-grey cone roof both go to accent (vermilion) over iris shade, threshold -0.2 (a red-roofed, red-banded white tank); platform, railing, roof rim and footing pads sky over iris shade; legs and braces iris, flat (the ink outline separates them). The source's thin light seams on the roof cone are the rim colour and show as pale ribs. Faceted (smooth false), 968 tris. Static, no clips.
